name: Donald Beyer, Jr.
page_title: Donald Beyer, Jr.'s Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (VA) - District 8

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Awful news from our neighbor to the south. Since the Supreme Court’s disastrous Dobbs decision, Republicans have passed or are on the verge of passing abortion bans in every state across the southeast. Only Virginia stands alone. Make no mistake — they want to ban it here too."

"Like many of you, when I heard the Supreme Court had overturned Roe, I immediately went to the SCOTUS building. This is a dark and discouraging moment, but it does not end here. We can’t give up, we must take heart for the struggle ahead — much of which will happen in the states."
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund
Voted in favor of HR 8297 "Ensuring Access to Abortion Act"

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "As the President talks about asking the wealthy and corporations to pay a fair share of taxes, it's worth noting that the American middle class is getting huge tax *cuts* from @POTUS' American Rescue Plan."
"I support tax increases that would make the wealthy pay their fair share."
"Mitch McConnell fights to protect billionaires from having to pay their fair share while mocking middle class tax cuts that help working people pay for basic necessities. Priorities!"
Voted against HR 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: "I support tax increases that would make the wealthy pay their fair share."

"The investments we make in American families and the workforce are paid for by making the wealthiest and the largest corporations pay their fair share. But this isn't just about money: the Build Back Better Act takes the boldest action to fight the climate crisis in our history."

"Today I joined my friend @RepCohen to introduce the Billionaire Minimum Income Tax Act, which does exactly what it sounds like. Making billionaires pay their fair share can help pay for urgent priorities like fighting climate change."
Voted against HR 1 "Tax Cuts and Jobs Act"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: Rated 0% by the Center for Security Policy

"Our just-passed bipartisan legislation will reduce the carbon footprint of the US military while increasing readiness. positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Couldn’t have a clearer contrast. We are investing in America’s infrastructure to make our rail system better while creating good-paying jobs. House Republicans are about to vote for a funding bill that would gut Amtrak’s budget, all as they keep seeking tax cuts for the rich."

"FULL STEAM AHEAD: we are thrilled to announce a ***$729 million*** investment in Virginia rail projects including the Long Bridge Project thanks to the bipartisan Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act! This is a huge deal for Virginia infrastructure!!!"

"June: CARES Act funds flowed; ~5M jobs added. July: CARES Act stimulus slowed, ~2M jobs added. August: CARES Act stops, ~1M added. Millions remain unemployed, permanent job losses and racial disparities are climbing. It's clear as day: Congress needs to pass more stimulus."
Voted in favor of HR 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Every American worker deserves paid sick and family leave and we can't stop fighting until they get it."

"Study after study has shown that having women in positions of business leadership helps the companies they lead foster more inclusive work practices and also boosts their bottom lines," said Rep. Beyer. "Promoting women to management helps eliminate unconscious bias, provides role models and mentors to others in the company ranks, and gives a powerful boost to internal advocates for pay equity and paid family leave. House resolutions are often symbolic, but sending this message matters, and it is my hope on International Women's Day that this gender parity legislation will inspire American businesses to do the right thing and promote more women up the ladder of leadership."

"The Build Back Better Act contains some of the most important benefits for American families ever contemplated by Congress: lowered drug prices, paid family leave, affordable child care and health care, universal pre-Kindergarten, and the extended child tax credit. Let's pass it."

"Every other industrialized nation gives its workers paid leave. Do opponents of paid leave think Americans deserve less? The American people deserve paid leave, and we should give it to them – and pay for it by making the wealthy pay their fair share of taxes like everyone else."
